decisions.notes: Reviewed the twelve-view contact sheet. Mint pickup with contrasting white cab, grille, round headlights, bed planks and whitewall tires. Appropriate for a stylized vehicle library.
limitations: Stylized procedural model, not photorealistic; surfaces and dimensions are simplified.
Static source GLB has no animation clips; functional operation and movable parts have not been verified.
Khronos validator: zero errors, 5 warning(s) for runtime-generated tangent space; normal-map shading may differ between engines.
Automatically authored experimental animation was not reviewed and its generated GLB is excluded; preview frames and report remain as intake evidence.
Blender reports 6 zero-area triangles out of 16,872.
